You arrived sooner than I expected. I hope I haven't interrupted your rest.
strings.(오래 쉬면 안 될 것 같아. 괜히 또 신경 쓰이고….): (I shouldn't rest too long. It only gives me more time to worry...)
strings.자네가 데이나를 만나러 가는 걸 보긴 했지만, 이렇게 제대로 이야기를 나: I've seen you on your way to meet Dayna, but speaking with you properly feels rather extraordinary. I've never met a hero who saved the world before...
I don't think I've earned that title yet.
strings.후후, 뭐 어떤가. 그런 건 자랑해도 되네. 여신의 망나니보다 영웅이란: Heh, why not? You can be proud of that. Surely 'hero' is a better title than the Goddess's Executioner?
Now, allow me to introduce myself properly.
strings.내 이름은 테오도르. 한 때 제국 아카데미에서 학생들을 가르쳤었네. 지금: My name is Theodore. I once taught at the Imperial Academy. I'm retired now, of course...
strings.데이나와 이야기를 했으니 알 수도 있겠군. 데이나 자매를 가르치기도 했: You may already know, since you've spoken with Dayna. I taught her and her sisters.
Then you were a tutor to the imperial...
strings.후후, 자네는 많은 걸 알고 있군. 하지만, 데이나를 비롯해 자매 이야기: Heh, you know quite a bit. Still, I wouldn't say too much about Dayna and her sisters.
It wouldn't do you any favors...
strings.위험해질 수 있다는 건가요?: Would it put me in danger?
strings.아니, 엄청나게 귀찮아질 거야. 자네도 알고 있겠지만, 제국과 관련된 일: No, it would become a tremendous nuisance. As you probably know, anything involving the empire usually does.
There's no need for 'Professor.' Just call me Theo.
All right, Theo. Please tell me why you called for me.
strings.이런저런 이야길 하다 보니 늦었군. 자네, 혹시 이스트랜드의 지스크 영지: I've let our conversation get away from me. Have you heard of Zisk Territory in Eastland?
strings.그래. 모스 왕국 때문에 이스트랜드의 역사를 찾던 중에 흥미로운 부분을: Certainly. While researching Eastland's history because of the Kingdom of Moss, I came across something interesting.
strings.고대 시절, 신들이 마왕과 싸운 시기. 이스트랜드는 어떤 신이 대지로 떨: In ancient times, when the gods fought the Demon King, a god fell to the earth and nearly destroyed Eastland itself.
strings.마침 또 비슷한 시기에 하늘에서 거대한 운석이 떨어져서, 이스트랜드는 소: Around the same time, a massive meteorite fell from the sky, bringing Eastland to the brink of annihilation.
strings.다행히도 어떤 힘으로 부활하긴 했지만, 자연 상태는 많이 달라졌다네. 어: Some power fortunately restored it, but its natural environment changed considerably. Some regions have entirely red soil; others grow strange plants...
strings.운석은 이스트랜드의 저주일 수도 있지만, 한 편으로는 축복이나 다름없었네: The meteorite may have been a curse upon Eastland, but it was also a blessing. It contained a mysterious mineral called meteoric iron.
strings.운철이 가진 힘이 이스트랜드의 문명을 이끌었지…. 그리고 여러 나라의 흥: The power of that iron drove Eastland's civilization forward... and brought nations to glory and ruin. It laid the foundations for war and conflict, supplying weapons, magical tools, and more.
strings.그래도 운석이 있던 자리는 하울 왕국의 귀족인 지스크 가가 소유하면서 무: But when House Zisk, a noble family of the Kingdom of Howl, took ownership of the impact site, they banned indiscriminate mining. The iron could only be used to make essential tools for the people and the kingdom.
strings.하지만, 데이모스 교단이 하울 왕국을 습격하고, 왕국이 사라지면서 그곳은: Then the Deimos cult attacked Howl. The kingdom fell, and the land became the property of the Dark Holy Kingdom.
strings.그 장소에 대한 이야기를 하시는 걸 보면 왠지 제가 거기 가야할 것 같군: Since you're telling me all this, I have a feeling I'm going there.
strings.그래, 맞아. 지스크 영지의 후계자께서 자네를 부르셨네. 자네에게 줄 수: That's right. The heir to Zisk Territory has asked for you. He says he has something to give you...
strings.잠시만요, 후계자가 지금까지 살아있다고요? 암흑전쟁이라면 몇백 년 전이라: Wait, the heir is still alive? I heard the Dark War was hundreds of years ago.
strings.자네도 알고 있는 분일 거야. 흐음, 지스크 영지는 지금 데이모스 암흑: You already know him, I believe. Hmm, Zisk Territory belongs to the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos now, but I've heard the Alliance of Light can reach parts of it.
Could you mean Sir Ziskad? His name does sound like Zisk Territory...
strings.잘 알고 있군. 지스카드 경이 맞네. 데이나와 이야기가 끝났으니까 가서: Well deduced. It is Sir Ziskad. I've already spoken with Dayna, so you should go and meet him.
Head to Lumen first and inquire there.
strings.(일단 유란에게 가서 물어봐야겠다. 그런데 검신께서 주신다고 하는 것이: (I'll ask Yuran first. But what could the Sword Master want to give me?)
So I'll handle Master's instructions this way, and the rest...
strings.(매번 느끼지만, 언제나 바빠 보여.): (Every time I see her, she looks busy.)
You're here. My apologies. I had so much to take care of that I didn't notice you arrive.
strings.괜찮아요. 그런데 지스카드 님께서는 어디 계신가요? 부르셨다고 들었는데…: It's fine. Where is Sir Ziskad? I heard he asked for me...
He was here at alliance headquarters just a moment ago...
He isn't here, but he'll be waiting for you. You should go to him.
How do I get to Zisk Territory? I'm not familiar with it...
Zisk Territory is near White Col Canyon.
strings.그러고 보니 생각보다 가까운 곳에 있었네요?: Oh, it's closer than I thought!
strings.네, 맞습니다. 데이모스 교단이 장악하고 있던 곳이라 오래전 스승님께서: Yes. The Deimos cult had occupied it, so long ago, Master sealed the entrance with the Kingdom of Jude's help.
strings.데이모스 교단이 지스크 영지를 넘어 화이트 콜 협곡까지 오는 걸 막기 위: He wanted to keep the cult from advancing through Zisk Territory into White Col Canyon...
strings.지금 지스카드 님께서 입구에 계신다는 건, 입구의 봉인이 해제됐다는 거죠: If he's at the entrance now, does that mean the seal is gone?
Master destroyed the seal with his sword aura.
There appear to be no traces of the Deimos cult there now.
strings.저는 자세한 내막은 알 수 없습니다만, 현재 그곳엔 데이모스 교단의 흔적: I don't know the details, but there seem to be no signs of the Deimos cult there at present.
strings.분명 대륙 중심은 데이모스 교단, 암흑 성국의 영역일텐데. 전체적으로 광: The center of the continent should be the cult's domain, the Dark Holy Kingdom. Yet reports say the overall number of fanatics and other inhabitants is declining.
We suspect it may be connected to whatever Weiss is doing.
I'll investigate further and let you know later.
strings.네, 알겠습니다. 그럼 그 입구는 정확히 어디쯤이죠?: Understood. So where exactly is the entrance?
At the far end, through the Jewel Tree Forest.
Oh, there. I've passed it a few times... I'll be on my way, then.
strings.이리스 님께서는 모험가님을 믿고, 온전히 모험가님과 함께할 날을 기다리고: Lady Iris believes in you. She is waiting for the day when she can be fully by your side.
Please take care of yourself and return safely.
strings.(화이트 콜 협곡 안쪽을 통해 들어온 새로운 장소. 불길함이 가득한 느낌: (Beyond the depths of White Col Canyon lies an unfamiliar place. An ominous feeling hangs over it, but quickly fades, perhaps dispelled by the presence of a middle-aged man.)
strings.(지스카드 앞에 있던 동물들이 모험가의 등장에 도망간다.): (The animals in front of Ziskad scatter when the adventurer arrives.)
Yes, Sir Ziskad. I heard you called for me.
strings.그래, 와줘서 고맙네. 그나저나 녀석들이 밥을 다 못 먹고 갔는데, 아쉽: I did. Thank you for coming. A shame those little ones left before finishing their meal. I'll have to call them back later.
I'm sorry I frightened them away.
It's all right. Ah, I owe you my thanks.
strings.덕분에 이스트랜드의 악이 하나 사라졌어. 모스 왕국과 모스 왕국을 조종하: Thanks to you, one source of evil has vanished from Eastland. The Kingdom of Moss, and the false Agasuras controlling it...
strings.반이라는 자의 최후를 봤겠군. 그의 기운이 다른 세계로 '전이'되는 걸: You must have witnessed the end of the one called Ban. I felt his energy 'transfer' into another world.
You felt that...? Lady Shynic and Lady Medea said something similar before...
strings.사실 나도 느끼고 싶지 않지만, 초인이라는 위치에 있는 이상 느낄 수밖에: Truthfully, I would rather not feel it, but as a Champion, I cannot help it.
strings.자네도 알고 있을지 모르겠지만, 초인이 가진 힘은 신의 힘의 일부…. 정: You may already know this, but a Champion's power is part of a god's power... though I cannot say exactly which god...
It bears the influence of the ancient gods who once dwelled here in Eastland, in Creta...
strings.부디 이 힘을 얻는 자가 일곱 명의 초인이라 불리는 자들 외에는 없길 바: I can only hope that no one beyond those known as the seven Champions gains this power.
strings.빛의 연합 맹주의 자격으로 자네에게 한 가지 청이 있네. 이 일은 이리스: As leader of the Alliance of Light, I have a favor to ask of you. It is for Miss Iris's sake as well.
I know you will not refuse... and for that, I am truly sorry.
strings.(저 멀리서 낯설지 않은 검은 머리의 소녀가 걸어오고 있다.): (A familiar black-haired girl approaches from a distance.)
Master, I'm here. And %s... I haven't seen you since then.
strings.스승님께서 이 사람을 부르셨습니까?: Did you summon this person, Master?
strings.그래, 널 이곳에 부른 이유는 다름이 아니라 이 사람을 도와 처리할 일이: Yes. I called you here because there is a task you must help our guest accomplish.
strings.그러기 전에 엘, %s 에게 예의를 갖춰라. 빛의 연합과 대륙을 위해 많: First, Ell, show %s proper respect. This is a hero who has done much for our alliance and the continent.
If that is your command, Master, I will obey.
You can speak to me casually. Like before, the way Ull does.
Oh. Like before. The way Ull does...
strings.(엘의 표정이 순간 굳어졌다 풀린다. 마치 감히 나와 울을 비교하다니…라: (Ell's expression briefly hardens, then relaxes. It seems to say, 'How dare you compare me to Ull?')
strings.아닙니다. 스승님의 뜻이기도 하고, 그만큼 모두를 위한 분이니 예를 다하: No. It is my master's wish, and you have done so much for everyone. I will show you the respect you deserve.
Then I'll keep speaking to you the way I always have.
Now, let me explain what you must do here.
I would like you to search for traces of a relic. A divine relic...
A relic? I thought the gods' relics were only in Freios...
strings.자네가 알고 있는 것보다 알려지지 않은 게 많네. 숨겨져서 모르고 있는: There is much that remains unknown beyond what you know. Some things may simply be hidden from us...
strings.그 유물은 '진실의 불꽃'이네. 불꽃 앞에 기도하는 자에게 궁금해하는 진: This relic is the 'Flame of Truth.' It is said to reveal the truth someone seeks when they pray before its fire.
strings.진실을 알게 된 자는 대륙을 몇 번이나 살리기도 했고, 위험에 빠뜨리기도: Those who learned its truths have saved the continent more than once, and endangered it as well. Because of that risk, the Kingdom of Howl chose a sacred place to keep it.
That place is Zisk Territory, where the Star of the Void remains... right here.
strings.고대 시절, 신과 마왕의 싸움 속에 세계가 흔들렸지. 그 여파로 하늘의: In ancient times, the battle between the gods and the Demon King shook the world. In its aftermath, a star fell here from the sky. That meteorite is called the Star of the Void...
strings.태양신 아그니가 떨어지지 않기 위해 별을 붙잡았는데, 같이 떨어지고 말았: One tale says the sun god Agni caught hold of a star to keep from falling, only to fall with it... though I cannot vouch for that account.
strings.하여튼, 소멸 위기까지 갔던 대륙이 여러 이상한 기후를 품게 됐지. 운석: In any case, the continent nearly perished and was left with many strange climates. The area around the impact was devastated, but over time, people began to benefit from the meteorite.
strings.운석에서 나온 특별한 금속, 운철이 이스트랜드와 하울 왕국의 문명을 발전: The special metal it yielded, meteoric iron, advanced civilization in Eastland and the Kingdom of Howl. But the technology built upon that iron also led countless lives to their deaths.
Perhaps that was inevitable on a continent steeped in conflict.
strings.설명이 길었군. 그래서 자네가 '진실의 불꽃'을 찾아줬으면 해. 영지 어: I've gone on long enough. I would like you to find the Flame of Truth. I am certain it is somewhere in this territory...
strings.어딘가에서 수상한 힘이 느껴지지 않나?: Can you sense a suspicious power somewhere?
Yes. There's definitely something in there.
strings.나는 그 힘이 느껴지지만, 찾아낼 수 없을 것 같네. 내가 아니라면 다른: I can feel that power, but I doubt I can locate it. If I cannot, others will likely fare no better. That is why I called for you; I believe you are suited to the task.
strings.성계신의 위치에 있는 이리스 양과 정신적으로 연결된 자네라면 찾을 수 있: I thought you might find it through your spiritual connection to Miss Iris, who holds the position of the God of the Astral Realm.
strings.그걸 찾아주게. 그게 있다면 빛의 연합이 이스트랜드를 위해 할 수 있는: Please find it. With its help, we could learn what the Alliance of Light can do for Eastland...
And you could discover the answers you seek.
strings.결심이 선 것 같은 표정이군. 이리스 양도 자네가 그러길 바라며 허락했네: You look as though you have made up your mind. Miss Iris approved as well, hoping you would do this. Go with Ell.
If Iris agrees... then we'll go.
strings.영지 중심에 수상한 기운이 있는 것 같은데, 그곳을 먼저 확인해보게. 부: The suspicious energy seems to be at the center of the territory. Look there first. Please be careful.
strings.오랜만에 사람이네요♪: It's been so long since anyone came here. ♪
A few monsters, but nothing we can't handle. I mean... nothing you need worry about. Forgive me. I'm not used to this yet...
strings.저는 괜찮아요. 차차 익숙해지겠죠. 그런데 누가 노래를 부르는 거지?: It's fine. You'll get used to it. But who's singing?
strings.역시 이 사람들에게 제 모습은 보이지 않겠죠♬: They probably won't be able to see me either. ♬
What? As you know, I'm Ell...
strings.어? 제가 보이세요? 제 목소리가 들리세요?: Huh? You can see me? You can hear my voice?
Yes. I can see you, so that's what I'm saying. If you're asking how I can see you...
strings.지금 누구랑 이야기하시고 있는 것…. 에이, 설마 유령이라도 있는 겁니까: Who are you talking to...? Oh, come on. Don't tell me there's a ghost here!
Oh, you can't see her, Ell? The girl standing right here...
I'm sorry! Whatever I did, I'm sorry, so please stop! Waaah...
strings.엘도 무서워하는 게 있네요. 여기 있는 소녀의 발끝이 흐린 걸 보니 꼭: So there is something you're afraid of. Her feet look a little hazy, just like a ghost's...
strings.그, 그만!! 그럼 전 저쪽에서 잠깐 쉬고 있을 테니 그 유, 유령님과: S-stop! I'll rest over there for a while. Call me when you're done chatting with the g-ghost.
strings.(엘이 괜찮은 척 하는 것 같지만, 살짝 겁을 먹은 표정으로 물러난다.): (Ell tries to look composed, but backs away with fear written faintly across her face.)
strings.…놀릴 생각은 없었는데…, 그나저나 당신은 누구시죠?: ...I wasn't trying to tease her... Anyway, who are you?
I should have introduced myself. I'm Jenna. Jenna Zisk.
strings.제나, 예쁜 이름이네요. 만나서 반가워요. 저는 %s…, 편하게 불러주세: Jenna. That's a lovely name. It's nice to meet you. I'm %s. You can just call me that.
strings.다행이에요. 여기서 저를 볼 수 있는 사람을 만날 수 있어서…. 이렇게: I'm so glad to meet someone here who can see me... Someone who can listen to my story...
strings.간혹 사람들이 다니긴 하지만, 저를 보지 못해 늘 지나쳤거든요…. 제가: People pass through sometimes, but they never see me. They always walk right by... You don't seem troubled by seeing me. Or even surprised...
Well, I've had a few unusual experiences...
strings.아, 잠깐 지스크? 지스크? 이곳이 지스크 영지라고 들었어요. 아, 그렇: Oh, wait. Zisk? Zisk? They told me this was Zisk Territory. Then that means...
strings.맞아요. 저는 이 땅의 주인, 영주셨던 아버지의 딸이에요. 사람들은 영주: That's right. My father was the lord of this land. As his daughter, people used to address me as a young lady of the house.
strings.저희 오라버니는 세상 사람들이 검신이라 불리는 사람이에요. 동물들을 참: My older brother is the man the world calls the Sword Master. He loves animals.
Oh, then... I'd better explain why I'm here.
strings.(제나에게 어떤 일로 왔는지 간단하게 설명한다.): (The adventurer briefly explains the reason for coming.)
strings.여신의 심부름꾼이라 절 보실 수 있었던 거군요. 그리고 오라버니의 부탁으: So you can see me because you're the goddess's messenger. And you came here at my brother's request...
strings.저기, %s…. 대화 중에 죄송한데, 아무래도 이쪽으로 몬스터가 오는 것: Excuse me, %s... Sorry to interrupt, but monsters seem to be heading this way. We should deal with them.
strings.아, 잠시 후에 이야기할까요? 그럼 다녀오세요. 전 걱정하지 마세요. 아: Oh, shall we talk afterward? Go ahead. Don't worry about me. No one can hurt me.
Please be careful. There's something I'd like to tell you.
strings.…으, 으으…. 빨리 다녀오죠…. 으으…. 그런데 유령은 어디에 있다는: ...U-ugh... Let's hurry... Ugh... But where is the ghost?
I'll just listen to your conversation for a while.
All right, Ell. The ghost... I mean, Jenna, seems a little disappointed, though...
Ugh... She really is there, right? Please, don't mind me. Just talk with %s.
strings.네, 감사드려요. 그럼 모험가님. 제가 이야기를 시작해도 될까요?: Of course. Thank you. Then, Adventurer, may I begin?
I've been waiting here for a long time for someone who could see me.
I don't know exactly how long. Four hundred years, and who knows how much longer...
strings.대륙에 큰 전쟁이 일어났었다고 들었어요. 정확히는 자연스레 알게 됐다고: I heard there was a great war on the continent. Or perhaps I should say I somehow came to know it.
strings.데이모스 교단이 대륙의 패권을 잡기 위해 일으킨 전쟁…. 그 전쟁의 발판: A war the Deimos cult started to seize control of the continent... To establish a foothold for that war, they attacked our territory first.
strings.하울 왕국과 지스크 영지는 교단의 습격을 어느 정도 방어했다고 생각했지만: We thought Howl and Zisk Territory were holding them off fairly well, but everything collapsed in an instant.
strings.광신도들은 눈에 보이는 생명을 모두 죽였고, 저와 오라버니는 어떻게든 도: The fanatics killed every living thing they saw. My brother and I tried desperately to escape, but...
Just before we could make it out through White Col Canyon...
strings.저는 이런 모습이지만, 그래도 오라버니가 살아계셔서 다행이에요. 그리고: This is what became of me, but I'm glad my brother survived. And that he's working for everyone's sake...
strings.지스카드 님은 지금 제나의 상태를 모르시나요?: Does Sir Ziskad know what's happened to you?
strings.얼마 전에 입구의 봉인이 해제돼서 근처에 오셨지만, 유령의 존재까지는 알: He came near here after the entrance was unsealed recently, but he doesn't seem able to sense my ghost.
He can't come in here, and I can't reach the entrance.
strings.제가 보이는 건 모험가님 뿐인 것 같아요. 광신도들이 북쪽에서 이곳으로: You seem to be the only person who can see me. Even when the fanatics come in from the north, they just pass by.
strings.아, 광신도들이 왜 있나 했더니 입구가 화이트콜 협곡 쪽에만 있는 곳이: Oh, I wondered why there were fanatics here. White Col Canyon isn't the only entrance, then. There's one on the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos's side.
strings.네, 맞아요. 제가 왜 유령의 상태로, 죽었을 때의 기억을 간직한 상태로: That's right. I don't know why I woke up as a ghost, still remembering the moment I died.
strings.그리고 영지를 벗어나지 못해요. 분명 이유가 있겠죠?: And I can't leave the territory. There must be a reason, don't you think?
strings.흠, 일단 지스카드 님께 말씀드려야 할 것 같은데….. 혹시라도 그 이유: Hmm. I should tell Sir Ziskad first... Maybe he can find a way to learn why.
strings.(영지를 벗어나지 못하는 건 미뉴에트를 만났을 때와 같네.): (Being unable to leave the territory... It's like when I met Minuet.)
He should be nearby. I'll go and come right back.
strings.너무 걱정하지 마세요. 제나의 오빠라면서요. 제나가 저에게 보이는 것도: Don't worry too much. He's your brother, after all. And I don't think it's a coincidence that I can see you.
Adventurer, I have a favor to ask.
strings.지스크 영지에 피는 꽃 한 송이를 구해서 오라버니께 드릴 수 있나요? 하: Could you pick a flower that grows here and give it to my brother? A white chrysanthemum.
Of course. I'll be back. Ell, wait here a moment.
Yes. What?! What?! Y-yes?! Please don't leave me alone...
Ahaha... Please don't be so frightened. Maybe I could sing you a cheerful song...
I was a little surprised when I sensed you coming back...
Well, tell me. What happened in the center of the territory?
I don't know if you'll believe me, but...
strings.(영지 한 편에 있던 소녀, 지스카드의 여동생 제나의 유령을 만난 이야기: (The adventurer explains meeting the ghost of Jenna, Ziskad's younger sister, in the territory.)
strings.자네, 지금 뭐라 했지? 제나? 제나가 그곳에 있다고?: What did you just say? Jenna? Jenna is there?
And she asked me to pick this and give it to you.
strings.(제나의 부탁대로 지스카드에게 꽃을 건넨다.): (The adventurer gives Ziskad the flower, as Jenna requested.)
strings.제나, 제나가 이 꽃을 기억하고 있었군…. 영지에서 쉽게 찾아볼 수 있는: Jenna... Jenna remembered this flower... They used to grow everywhere in our land, but now they're so hard to find...
She loved ornaments made from these flowers...
strings.그래. 자네가 한 말은 모두 사실일세. 나는 내 동생 제나와 데이모스 교: Yes. Everything you said is true. I tried to escape the Deimos cult together with my sister Jenna.
strings.부모님께서는 영주의 의지로 영지를 지키셔야 한다고 둘 만이라도 나가게 하: Our parents said it was their duty as lords to defend the territory, and sent the two of us away.
strings.난 모두 잘 될거라 믿고 제나와 함께 여기까지 왔었네. 내 검에 자신이: I brought Jenna this far, believing everything would be all right. I had faith in my sword. But...
strings.나는 제나를 지킬 수 있을 거라 생각했다. 그렇게 믿기도 했으니까. 하지: I thought I could protect Jenna. I truly believed it. But it was all arrogance, born of treating the sword too lightly.
strings.광신도의 습격으로 제나가 피를 흘리며 쓰러지고, 나는…. 아무것도 하지: The fanatics attacked, and Jenna fell bleeding. And I... I could do nothing...
Forgive me. I let my emotions get the better of me...
It's all right. I shouldn't have brought...
No. Memories I had pushed aside came back so suddenly... I am the one who should apologize.
strings.나는 이곳에 제나를 묻었네. 그리고 복수심을 다스리지 못하고 교단의 광신: I buried Jenna here. Then, unable to master my thirst for vengeance, I began hunting down and cutting down the cult's fanatics.
People knew nothing of that. They followed me, simply hoping for a brighter future for our continent. When they called me a Sword Saint, it struck me like a blow.
strings.(아, 빛의 연합 사람들인가?): (Oh, does he mean the people of the Alliance of Light?)
strings.그래서 나는 그들을 위해서, 대륙을 위해서…. 그리고 제나와 가족들, 희: I realized I had to use my sword rightly again. For them, for the continent... and for Jenna, my family, and every life that had been taken.
strings.옛이야기가 길었네. 미안하군. 하지만, 그…. 제나의 유령이 자네에게만: I've dwelled on the past long enough. Forgive me. But I don't know why... why Jenna's ghost is visible only to you.
It is as though something is influencing her...
strings.유물을 발견하게 된다면 진실을 알아낼 수 있는 기회를 써야겠군…. 그 기: If we find the relic, we must use a chance to learn the truth... though I don't know how many chances it will grant...
strings.네, 그러면 제나에게 뭐라고 이야기할까요?: All right. What should I tell Jenna?
strings.유물을 찾게 되면 알 수 있을 거라고 전해주게…. 나도 안으로 들어가고: Tell her we may learn the answer if we find the relic... I would like to go inside myself, but... I cannot...
Oh, is that so...? Then Ell and I will keep searching for the relic.
Thank you. For not asking further...
strings.언제쯤 어디쯤 오시려나. 기다리고 있는 시간이♬: When will you come, where might you be? The hours pass as I wait for you. ♬
strings.…으, 으…. 어디선가 음침한 기운이…. 마치 유령이 노래라도 부르는 것: ...U-ugh... There's something so eerie nearby... It's almost as if a ghost were singing.
%s, you're back. I've been waiting for you.
Yes, I'm back. Sorry, Ell. I left you alone for too long.
strings.아닙니다. 전 잠깐 주위를 둘러보고 올테니 말씀 나누세요. 오래 걸리진: It's all right. I'll take a quick look around, so please talk. I won't be long.
That wait must have been hard on her. Oh, Jenna. I've spoken with Sir Ziskad.
strings.(지스카드와 나눴던 이야기를 제나에게 전달한다.): (The adventurer relays the conversation with Ziskad to Jenna.)
I see. I'll help however I can.
strings.그럼 '진실의 불꽃'이라는 걸 아시나요?: Do you know about something called the Flame of Truth?
strings.잘은 모르지만, 부모님께 들어서 그게 어떤 건지는 조금 알고 있어요. 그: Not much, but my parents told me a little about what it is. I don't know where it is, though.
I do have one idea: the Star of the Void over there.
strings.영지 주민들은 운석에 별의 기운이 사람들을 이롭게 만들어준다며 신성시했어: The people revered the meteorite, saying its star energy blessed them. I sometimes went there to pray, too.
strings.운석에서 나온 운철이 모두를 풍족하게 만들기도 했어요. 데이모스 교단이: Its meteoric iron brought prosperity to everyone. After the Deimos cult occupied this place, all the iron they mined was shipped somewhere else.
What could the cult possibly want it for...?
strings.…그곳에 한 번 가보세요. 허무의 별은 지스크 영지 제일 안 쪽에 있어요: ...You should try looking there. The Star of the Void is at the far end of Zisk Territory.
I was already sensing some kind of power lingering there.
strings.(바이스가 주던 불길함이나 마계의 기운 같은 건 아닌 것 같은데….): (It doesn't feel like the menace of Weiss, or energy from the Demon Realm...)
strings.%s 님, 확인이 필요한 곳이 있습니다. 수상한 존재와 몬스터들이 몰려: %s, there's a place we need to investigate. Suspicious beings and monsters are gathering there...
strings.혹시 저기 보이는 운석이 있는 방향인가요?: Is it in the direction of that meteorite?
strings.맞습니다. 그곳에서 나온 존재들이 지스크 영지를 가득 메우고 있는 것 같: Yes. The beings emerging from there seem to be filling Zisk Territory...
Please find the answers you're looking for.
Yes. I'm right beside you, Ell.
Let's go, %s. We'll get closer and assess the situation before making our move.
strings.이 지독한 기운…, 제가 알고 있는 데이모스 교단의 것이 아닙니다. 아니: This vile energy... It isn't the Deimos cult's energy that I know. No, it's as though something else is mixed into it...
I feel it too. There's definitely something inside the meteorite.
strings.여기에서 나오는 이질적인 존재들을 처리하고 안에 들어가는 것까지 하기엔: Dealing with all these strange creatures before going inside would take too long.
strings.그래서 밖으로 나오는 존재들을 베는 동안, %s 님께서 안으로 들어가셔서: So while I cut down the creatures coming out, %s, please go inside and investigate the ominous energy or any trace of the relic yourself.
strings.제가 가도 될까요?: Are you sure I should go?
strings.%s 님은 스승님께서 인정하셨을 뿐만 아니라, 제가 할 수 없는 일을 하: Master has acknowledged you, %s. And you can do things I cannot.
strings.저도 엘에게 인정받은 걸까요?: Does that mean you've acknowledged me, too?
I simply respect talent, whatever its form.
As long as you don't tease me about being afraid of... ghosts.
Now, let's hurry. That's enough chatting.
Then I'll be on my way.
strings.오라버니와 날 거두신 스승님을 위해 이곳의 일을 완벽하게 마무리하고 돌아: For the master who took in my brother and me, I'll see this task through perfectly before I return.
strings.(허무의 별에서 제일 깊은 곳, 수상한 기운이 느껴진다.): (A suspicious energy emanates from the deepest reaches of the Star of the Void.)
I wandered all the way inside, but that thing over there...
strings.(수상한 기운을 품고 있는 뱀 형상의 존재가 빤히 바라보고 있다.): (A serpent-shaped being filled with strange energy stares intently.)
You did well to find me. I've been waiting.
strings.뭐, 뭐지? 뱀인가? 아니, 일반적인 뱀은 아닌 것 같고. 사람의 말을: Wh-what is that? A snake? No, it doesn't seem like an ordinary snake. And it's speaking...
Suddenly, I remember something he once said to someone like you.
strings.자신의 할 일에 큰 방해가 된다고! 거기서 처리하지 않으면 후회하게 될: That you would be a great obstacle to his work! That he would regret not disposing of you then and there!
strings.대체 무슨 말이야? 너는 누구지?: What are you talking about? Who are you?
I may not be him, but I am his shadow... Me? Call me the Serpent's Shadow.
strings.뱀? 뱀 그림자? 그게 뭐지?: A serpent? The Serpent's Shadow? What's that supposed to mean?
You look utterly lost. Then let me explain.
strings.네가 아니라 너 같은 영혼을 가진 또 다른 사람이 온다면 분명히 이 말을: If another person with a soul like yours had come instead, they would surely understand these words.
strings.(뱀 그림자의 말에서 갑자기 오싹한 기분이 느껴진다.): (A sudden chill runs through the adventurer at the Serpent's Shadow's words.)
A soul like mine? What does that mean? But...
You may not understand, but you feel it instinctively.
I'll show you who my true self is, and what his will means.
strings.(갑자기 뱀 그림자가 입맛을 다신다.): (The Serpent's Shadow suddenly smacks its lips.)
strings.내가 깨어난 이상, 그의 의지를 거스를 순 없어. 그러니 내가 깨끗하게: Now that I have awakened, I cannot defy his will. So I'll swallow you whole.
My task is to destroy you, an obstacle to his will.
But with the power you possess, perhaps I could escape his will myself...
Shut up. Every last one of you goes on about power, power, power...
strings.그렇게 힘을 원한다면 제대로 상대해주지. 그가 누군지 모르겠지만, 그 의: If you want power so badly, I'll give you a proper fight. I don't know who 'he' is, but I'll break that will of his.
strings.넌 진실을 찾고 있군. 네가 진실을 감당할 수 없다면 그냥 삼켜지는 게: You seek the truth. If you cannot bear it, being swallowed would be the wiser choice.
strings.원하지 않는다고 해서 발동될 의지를 멈출 순 없다. 내가, 그리고 그가: Not wanting it will not stop that will from being set in motion. I desire it, and so does he...
strings.그 말 후회하게 해주지. 내가 그 '의지'란 걸 지금 여기서 멈출 거니까: I'll make you regret those words. I'm stopping this 'will' right here and now.
strings.(뱀 그림자가 말이 끝나기가 무섭게 입을 크게 벌려 거대한 송곳니를 드러: (The instant it finishes speaking, the Serpent's Shadow opens its jaws wide, baring enormous fangs.)
Impossible... His will, overcome by a mere human...
Even if I am only a shadow...
strings.(뱀 그림자의 움직임이 둔해진다. 그러다 점차 모습이 흐릿해지기 시작한다: (The Serpent's Shadow slows. Its form gradually begins to fade.)
He will no longer permit me to exist...
strings.오랫동안 그의 의지를 지키고자 살아왔던 내가 인간에게 밀렸다는 이유만으로: After living so long to uphold his will, all because a human bested me...
It seems this person you keep mentioning doesn't think much of you.
strings.어쩌면 네 의지가 순간적으로 그를 넘어섰을지도…. 그래, 넌 보통 인간이: Perhaps your will surpassed his for a moment... Yes, you were never an ordinary human.
strings.그럴지도 몰라. 난 이미 보통의 인간이라고 하기엔 너무 많은 일을 겪었어: Maybe. I've been through far too much to call myself ordinary anymore.
That is not what I mean...
strings.너는 너 자신을 정말 모르는군. 진실을 알지 못한 채로 망각으로 향하는: You truly know nothing of yourself. Though it does suit a human to walk toward oblivion without ever learning the truth...
The one who rose from human to god also knows far too little. If you wish to know...
strings.그게 무슨 소리지? 말해!!: What do you mean? Tell me!
strings.내가 사라진 자리에서 신이 모르고 있는 진실을 보게 해라. 그녀가 제일: Have her look where I vanish and witness the truth unknown to a god. She will give you the wisest answer.
Ouroboros. How can you leave me like this... like...
strings.(뱀 그림자의 모습이 사라져 더 이상 보이지 않는다.): (The Serpent's Shadow vanishes without a trace.)
I... I didn't even get a proper answer. What on earth is going on...?
%s, I'm sorry to appear so suddenly...
The Serpent's Shadow said to look where it disappeared...
It seems to be something only I can see. Something visible only to my eyes...
Let me take a look, and I'll tell you.
strings.(이리스의 환영이 뱀 그림자가 사라진 자리를 빤히 응시한다.): (Iris's apparition stares at the spot where the Serpent's Shadow vanished.)
strings.(갑자기 경험하지 않았던 다른 곳의 기억이 정리되지 않은 채 떠오른다.): (Unordered memories of an unfamiliar place suddenly rise to the surface.)
strings.(이리스가 보고 있는 게 지금 나에게도….): (What Iris is seeing... I'm seeing it too...)
strings.(갑자기 다른 어떤 여성의 모습이 떠오른다. ): (The image of another woman suddenly appears.)
I am Nii. Guardian of Luminous City...
strings.(위그드라실에서 본 여성이지만, 다른 사람 같다. 다른 존재인 건가?): (I saw her at Yggdrasil, but she seems different. Is she another being?)
strings.루미너스 시티의 사람들은 아직 그 존재를 모르지만, 머지 않아 루미너스: The people of Luminous City do not yet know of its existence, but soon Luminous, too, will become part of these worlds.
strings.우리가 이 세계의 붕괴를 막기 위해 이곳에 남아있는 한, 우로보로스를 쫓: As long as we remain here to prevent this world's collapse, you are the only one who can pursue Ouroboros.
strings.(…오딘도 그때의 오딘이 아냐….): (...That isn't the Odin I met, either...)
(It sounds as though they're speaking to me. But I have no memory of them... They're talking to someone else, so why does it sound like this?)
This isn't the time for that. The child Ouroboros captured...
Beyond time, into a world of the past... My beloved child of destiny...
strings.(알 수 없는 고통이 느껴져…. 으윽…. 저 사람, 용제성에서 봤었던 지: (A strange pain... Ugh... That person looks like the Emperor of Jiendia I saw at the Dragon Emperor's Castle...)
strings.(나와 이리스가 보고 있던 한 여인이 갑자기 눈을 맞추는 것 같다. 설마: (A woman in the vision Iris and the adventurer are watching seems to meet their eyes. Surely... it must be imagination?)
You are looking at me now, Iris.
Iris... Just as you wished, a world without pain or sorrow was created.
strings.세레스 님이 사랑하는 당신, 그런 당신의 의지로 탄생한 이곳은 너무 행복: You, whom Lady Seres loves... This place, born from your will, is so full of happiness.
strings.하지만 우로보로스가 이리스의 뜻을 잘못 이해하고 깨어났어요. 모든 것이: But Ouroboros misunderstood your wish and awoke. It is trying to make a world where nothing exists at all.
It was because of me. I... I...
Iris, it isn't your fault. The fault lies with those who torment you.
Those who are trying to devour your world now...
strings.오딘과 니이가 과거부터 지금까지 지켜냈듯이 이리스와 %s 모두가 할 수: Just as Odin and Nii have protected it from long ago until today, both you and %s can do it.
It is not your fault. You, who will become a great god...
We will meet someday. First, please help Iris.
strings.(그 말과 함께 앞에 나타났던 인물들의 모습이 점차 사라진다.): (With those words, the figures before them gradually fade.)
Iris, are you all right? None of this is your fault.
The being that awoke in the world I created... Ouroboros...
strings.이리스? 어디 간 거야? 헛….. 뭐지? 이 기분은?: Iris? Where did you go? Ah... What's this feeling?
strings.(갑자기 시야 앞에 펼쳐진 모든 것들이 일그러진다. 검은 틈이 열려 모두: (Everything in sight suddenly distorts. A black rift opens and begins to swallow it all.)
strings.(갑자기 모로스에서 반이 사라지는 장면이 떠오른다.): (The sight of Ban disappearing in Moros suddenly flashes through the adventurer's mind.)
strings.아, 안 돼!! 이곳에서 나가야 해!!: N-no! I have to get out of here!
Hah, hah... I barely got out.
strings.엘, 저는 괜찮아요. 엘도 괜찮아요?: Ell, I'm fine. Are you all right?
Whew... Let me catch my breath, and I'll explain. What happened was...
strings.(엘에게 허무의 별에서 있었던 일을 간단하게 이야기한다.): (The adventurer briefly tells Ell what happened inside the Star of the Void.)
...I see. What could that being have been, and why was it here...?
I don't know either. All I know is that it was called Ouroboros...
strings.허무의 별 쪽에서 바깥으로 나오던 몬스터와 악마를 비롯한 적들이 환영처럼: That being must be why the monsters, demons, and other enemies emerging from the Star of the Void vanished like illusions.
strings.일단 제나에게 돌아가죠. 여기선 알아낸 게 없지만 제나라면 뭔가 알고 있: Let's go back to Jenna for now. We didn't learn anything here, but she might know something.
strings.흐르는 눈물을 닦으라며. 바람이 나와 그대를 지나가네♪: The wind passes you and me, whispering to wipe away our falling tears. ♪
strings.뒷부분이 좀처럼 떠오르지 않아. 어떻게 부르는 거였지?: I just can't remember the next part. How did it go?
That was a lovely song, Jenna.
Thank you. I'm not very good, but I like humming to myself.
strings.유, 유령님께서 노래를 부르셨군요. 왠지 들려오는 것 같은 기분도 들고…: The g-ghost was singing, then. Somehow, I almost feel as if I can hear her...
Since you've come back to me, I suppose you didn't find the Flame of Truth.
strings.네, 혹시 더 가볼만한 곳이 있나요?: No. Is there anywhere else we could look?
strings.혹시 지금 뭔가가 느껴지지 않으신가요?: Do you feel something right now?
strings.글쎄요…. 아, 혹시 이리스를 말하는 건가요?: I'm not sure... Oh, do you mean Iris?
strings.이리스…? 아, 이곳에 오셨을 때 이야기해주신 신이 되신 분의 이름이군요: Iris...? Ah, the person who became a god, whom you told me about when you arrived.
strings.네, 맞아요. 이리스. 하지만, 이리스는 여기 없어요. 잠깐 왔다가 사라: Yes, Iris. But she isn't here. She came briefly and disappeared. It's complicated...
Could there be another godlike being here...?
strings.(제나의 말이 끝나기가 무섭게 주위에 한기가 느껴진다.): (No sooner has Jenna spoken than a chill settles over the area.)
strings.(제나의 질문에 주위 공기가 차가워진다. 방금 전까지 움직이고 있던 엘의: (At Jenna's question, the air grows cold. Ell, who was moving a moment ago, begins to freeze in place.)
You found me. I only approached because I wanted to hear your conversation.
strings.(어디선가 어떤 여성의 목소리가 들려온다.): (A woman's voice comes from somewhere nearby.)
strings.(나를 알고 있어…. 이 느낌은 가이아 님을 만났을 때와 같은 성스러움…: (She knows me... This feels sacred, like when I met Lady Gaia... But it's different. Slightly corrupted...)
strings.후후, 그러면 잠깐 이야기를 해볼까요?: Hehe. Then shall we talk for a moment?
strings.(말이 끝나기가 무섭게 세계가 갑자기 불길한 느낌으로 가득 찬다.): (The moment she finishes speaking, the world is filled with an ominous presence.)
strings.(예전에 누군가가 강제로 데리고 갔던 공간과 비슷한 느낌이다….): (It feels like that place someone once dragged me into against my will...)
strings.(하지만, 그저 지스크 영지가 어두워졌을 뿐인 것 같다.): (But it looks as though Zisk Territory has simply grown dark.)
1. You said you wanted to talk.
strings.(어둠 속에서 붉은 불꽃이 활활 타오르며 떠오른다.그리고 어떤 여성의 모: (A blazing red flame rises from the darkness, and a woman appears.)
I had hoped no one would come this far.
strings.(여성의 손 끝에서 붉은 불꽃이 타오르고 있다.): (Red flames burn at the woman's fingertips.)
But you came here. And you disturbed his shadow...
strings.(이어 여성의 다른 손에서 파란 불꽃이 타오른다. 서로 다른 색을 가진: (Blue flames flare in her other hand. Two flames, each a different color...)
strings.하고 싶은 말이 뭐죠? 그래서 당신은 누군가요?: What are you trying to say? Who are you?
strings.내 힘을 두려워했던 그들이 날 에트와르에 오지 못하도록 했는데, 지금은: Those who feared my power barred me from Etoile. Yet now they are gone.
strings.내 힘이 필요하다 그래서 보여준 것뿐인데, 날 추방했어요. 여기 내가 사: They said they needed my power, so I merely showed it to them. And they banished me from this world I love...
Beings destined only to perish, yet so afraid of the truth...
You bear the blessings of the children who stood with them.
Children who love humans so dearly...
Poor Seres, whom they used, and Gaia, whom they abandoned...
God... A name given by living beings to those with power whom they followed. Nothing more.
I will say it once more. Leave now.
strings.당신의 능력이 진실이라면, 당신이 사랑한 이 세계를 위해 진실을 알 수: If your power is truth, then let us learn the truth for the sake of this world you love.
I believe you are the first human to ask me.
strings.거기 소녀. 당신도 알 거예요. 내가 어떤 존재인지. 그리고 나란 위대한: You there, girl. You know what I am, too. And what you wish to ask of a great being such as myself...
Why am I here? I know I died...
strings.소녀와 모험가여, 당신들은 진실을 감당할 자신이 있나요?: Girl and adventurer, are you certain you can bear the truth?
I have to know. For everyone's sake... and for Iris.
strings.모두를 위한다는 건 인간들이 하는 확실한 거짓말…. 세레스가 만든 인간: 'For everyone's sake' is one of humanity's most certain lies... A descendant of the humans Seres created, a girl who has yet to become a true god...
strings.진실을 알고도 배척하지 않을 수 있을지 궁금하군요. 신이고 인간이고, 그: I wonder whether you can learn the truth without rejecting it. Gods and humans alike want nothing but power. They refuse to accept the truth!
strings.(레테의 목소리가 격해진다. 저 멀리 보이는 호숫가의 물길이 강하게 소용: (Lethe's voice grows heated. In the distance, the waters along the lakeshore churn into a violent whirlpool.)
strings.그가, 그가, 날 이리로 이끈 만큼 제대로 보여주겠어!!: He... He brought me here, and I will show you exactly what that means!
strings.(…신에게서 느껴지는 그런 느낌이 아냐. 이건…. 반대인…. 설마, 뒤틀: (...This isn't the feeling of a god. It's... the opposite... Could she be one of the Twisted?)
Ah. I became a little agitated.
strings.나는 아무도 오지 않기를 바랐어요. 하지만, 당신의 신이 여기까지 이끈: I wished for no one to come. But since your god has led you here, you had better be prepared.
strings.진실을 알 준비가 됐다면, 날 죽이러 오세요. 망각의 호숫가에서 기다리고: If you are ready to learn the truth, come and kill me. I will be waiting at the Lake of Oblivion.
strings.(어두웠던 지스크 영지가 다시 원래의 모습으로 시야에 들어온다.): (The darkened Zisk Territory returns to its original appearance.)
strings.%s 님, 한참 찾았습니다. 어디에 다녀오신 건가요?: %s, I've been looking everywhere. Where did you go?
strings.(엘에게 레테란 존재를 만났던 걸 이야기한다.): (The adventurer tells Ell about meeting the being called Lethe.)
It's hard to believe... but you experienced it yourself...
She did tell you to come if you wanted the truth...
Then what we're looking for must be there. Probably what she was holding...
You can see me? Then that means...
strings.레테의 영향이 있었던 것 같네요. 엘도 제나를 볼 수 있게 된 걸 보면…: It must be Lethe's influence. Since you can see Jenna now, too...
That's a relief. At least now I can see you...
Come to think of it, you do look a little like Master...
I am his only sister, after all.
strings.제 눈에 보여도 유령이신 건 마찬가지…. 히익, 다리가 없어. 다리가!!: But even if I can see you, you're still a ghost... Eek! You have no legs! No legs!
Ahaha... I think it's time I went.
Please wait here, Ell. I'm the only one Lethe is expecting.
All right. If it's you, Adventurer...
Thank you. Then please protect Jenna here. I'm counting on you, Ell.
Of course. May fortune favor you in battle.
Yes? I still can't get used to this. Talking to someone who has died...
Just think of it as talking to an ordinary ghost.
strings.진실이란 건 대체 뭘까요? 제가 알아도 괜찮은 걸까요?: What is the truth, exactly? Is it all right for me to know it?
strings.이런 말이 있습니다. 거짓은 양면의 동전 같은 거라 조금만 파고들어 돌리: There's a saying: a lie is like a coin with two sides. Dig a little deeper and turn it over, and the other side will appear. That side is the truth.
There's something unsettling about this place. As though enemies might attack at any moment...
strings.걱정 마세요. 스승님과 모험가님을 방해하는 모든 적들을 베어 버릴 테니까: Don't worry. I'll cut down every enemy who stands in my master's or the adventurer's way.
strings.(호숫가의 제일 마지막 길, 레테가 보이지 않는다.): (At the far end of the lakeshore path, Lethe is nowhere to be seen.)
Oh, over there... I think someone's there...
strings.뱀의 흔적을 겨우 찾았는데!! 신이라 믿는 멍청한 여자 때문에 망쳤어!!: I'd finally found a trace of the serpent! And some idiot woman who thinks she's a god ruined it!
I have no idea what you're talking about. Beast wearing a human's form...
Gods only ever see what suits them. They don't even consider looking at anything else.
Just as I thought. Perhaps the reason you were able to come here...
Urgh, that old man... What has he done this time...
strings.영감이 손을 댔으니 당신도 알겠지? 인간들이 신이라 부르는 존재가 어쩌면: If the old man had a hand in this, you must know too. What humans call gods might actually be...
strings.귀찮은 이야긴 그만 하고, 이제 한 번 해볼까? 신이 어디까지 할 수 있: Enough tedious talk. Shall we find out just how much a god can do?
Someone who thinks herself a god may find this laughable. But this...
Isn't everything a foolish god like you knows.
strings.(카즈노의 말이 끝나기가 무섭게 레테의 손에 있던 불꽃이 흔들리더니 작아: (As Kazno finishes speaking, the flames in Lethe's hands flicker and shrink.)
strings.(카즈노가 꺼져가는 불꽃을 보면서 괴로워하는 레테의 모습에 조소를 보인다: (Kazno sneers as Lethe suffers at the sight of her fading flames.)
strings.지금 이곳에서 네가 아끼는 그걸 전부 없앨 수 있다. 내가 이 힘을 쓰면: I could destroy everything you treasure right here. If I use this power... Ugh.
Urgh... Damn it, here of all places... Cough, cough.
strings.(카즈노가 주저앉더니 원래의 모습으로 돌아온다.): (Kazno collapses to the ground and returns to his original form.)
strings.약속대로 당신을 만나러 왔어. 레테. 그런데, 카즈노? 여기에 당신이 왜: I came to meet you as promised, Lethe. But... Kazno? Why are you here?
strings.젠장…, 여기서 들킬 줄이야. 쿨럭, 쿨럭…. 신경 쓰지 마라. 나는 나: Damn it... I never thought I'd be caught here. Cough, cough... Don't concern yourself. I have my own work to...
strings.(카즈노의 뒤로 모자를 쓴 소년의 모습이 천천히 걸어 나온다.): (A boy wearing a hat slowly walks out from behind Kazno.)
strings.카즈노, 이 자식!! 분명 내가 몸을 혹사시키면 가만 두지 않겠다고 했을: Kazno, you idiot! I told you I wouldn't let you off if you pushed your body too hard!
So that damned old man has meddled with someone else.
strings.당신들, 나를 너무 얕보는군요. 아무리 내가 오랜 시간, 이곳으로 오지: You underestimate me. However long I was unable to return here...
I may be on the same level as the beings you know as gods.
strings.우습군. 어리석은 신 따위 무서워할 줄 알아?!: Ridiculous. You think I'm afraid of some foolish god?
strings.(제릴의 한 마디에 잠잠했던 호숫가의 물결이 요동친다.): (At Jeril's words, the still waters of the lakeshore surge violently.)
strings.카즈노 대신 내가 손을 봐줄 수도 있지만, 지금 주인공은 내가 아니니 물: I could deal with you in Kazno's place, but this isn't my moment in the spotlight. I'll step aside.
strings.카즈노는 내가 데리고 갈테니, 일단 저기 어리석은 신이 초대한 파티는 제: I'll take Kazno away. You see to it that this foolish god's little party ends properly.
strings.죄인들의 대장들이 손을 썼으니 여신 셋이 사랑하는 네 녀석이 상대하기 쉬: The leaders of the sinners have already had a hand in things. You, beloved by three goddesses, should find her easy enough to handle.
strings.카즈노, 공주님 안기라고 들어 봤어? 아리따운 공주님이 아니고 카즈노라서: Kazno, ever heard of a princess carry? A shame you're Kazno instead of a lovely princess.
%s, see if you can give this place a happy ending.
strings.(제릴이 엷은 미소를 보이며 카즈노와 함께 그 자리에서 흔적도 없이 사라: (With a faint smile, Jeril vanishes without a trace, taking Kazno with him.)
Focus. I have to defeat the being in front of me.
strings.…순순히 그렇게 되진 않을 거예요. 자, 다가와요. 당신을 태울 진실의: ...It will not be so simple. Come closer. Approach the Flame of Truth that will burn you...
strings.(레테가 주저앉으면서 두 손에 있던 불꽃이 미끄러져 바닥으로 떨어진다.): (Lethe sinks to the ground, and the flames slip from her hands onto the earth.)
It seems even a former god made some kind of bargain to achieve something...
strings.(레테가 계속해서 불꽃을 손 위에 올려두려 하지만, 그때마다 열기에 놓치: (Lethe repeatedly tries to cradle the flames, but their heat makes her drop them each time.)
It isn't hot at all. But this...
strings.(진실의 불꽃이 손을 뻗는 %s의 가슴을 향해 파고든다.): (As %s reaches out, the Flame of Truth plunges into the adventurer's chest.)
...So this was the truth I refused to see.
The same ending as those I hated and despised...
strings.불꽃과의 재회의 이유는 이런 것이었군. 잘못된 선택을 한 날 꾸짖기 위해: So this is why I was reunited with the flames. To rebuke me for my wrong choice...
I told you. If you wanted the truth, you were to come and kill me.
strings.날 죽여요. 그러면 당신은 그토록 궁금했던 한 가지 진실을 알 수 있을: Kill me. Then you may learn one truth you have longed to know.
All I need is the Flame of Truth. I only want to use the truth to stop evil.
You are different from the others. Perhaps I misunderstood humans...
Yes. You are the one Seres and Gaia chose...
Then I will tell you one thing you wish to know. Something concerning you...
strings.당신의 존재가 궁금하긴 하지만, 지금 중요한 게 아니니까요, 저에 대한: I'm curious about you, but that isn't what matters right now. If it's a truth about me... it won't mean I have to kill you, will it?
Nothing of the sort. Do not doubt me. Accept it freely.
strings.그렇다면…, 저는 왜 기억을 잃은 건가요?: Then... why did I lose my memories?
strings.당신이 기억을 잃은 건, 새로운 신이 된 아이가 당신을 보호하기 위해서예: You lost your memories because the child who became a new god was trying to protect you.
So do not resent her. It would grieve Seres...
strings.(레테의 말이 끝나자마자 그녀의 모습이 사라져간다.): (As soon as Lethe finishes speaking, her form begins to fade.)
strings.특별한 힘을 가진 자만 한 번씩 진실을 알 수 있을 거예요. 내 불꽃을: Only those with special power may learn a truth, once each. Please treasure my flames.
strings.걱정하지 말아요. 나는 다시 원래 있었던 곳으로 돌아갈 뿐이에요. 진실인: Do not worry. I am merely returning to where I was before. A place that may be truth, or may be oblivion...
strings.(진실의 불꽃이 %s의 손에 미세한 보석 형태로 남겨져 있다.): (The Flame of Truth remains in %s's hand in the form of a tiny jewel.)
Were my memories really the only thing I wanted to know about?
For now, let's return to Ell and Jenna.
strings.다행입니다. 별일 없으셨죠?: What a relief. Nothing happened to you, did it?
I'm fine... I'll tell you what happened.
strings.(호숫가에서 있었던 일을 간단하게 이야기한다.): (The adventurer briefly explains the events at the lakeshore.)
strings.(엘과 제나가 이야기를 듣고 어느 정도 이해한다는 표정을 짓는다. 그러다: (Ell and Jenna seem to understand after hearing the story. Then Ell notices a man standing nearby.)
What a beautiful young lady. Lovely enough that I'd like to call you a princess...
strings.가, 감사합니다. 그런데 제가 어떻게 보이시는 거죠?: Th-thank you. But how can you see me?
strings.후후. 특별한 눈을 가지고 있어서 그래. 거기 %s, 나 기억해?: Hehe. I have special eyes. You there, %s. Remember me?
Your name was Jeril, wasn't it...?
strings.내 이름은 제대로 기억하는군. 원래 카즈노가 왔어야 하지만, 몸 상태가: At least you remember my name properly. Kazno should have come, but he's in no condition to do so. I came instead.
Don't talk about me. Unless you want...
Never mind that. Kazno had a message for you.
strings.어떤 진실을 알고 싶은 건지 잘 모르겠지만, 모두에게 좋은 게 없을 거야: I don't know what truth you want to learn, but there won't be one that's good for everyone.
And you, Adventurer, will be the one who makes that choice.
Tell him I already know that much.
strings.그리고 계속해서 뱀을 쫓을 거라고 하더군. 나도 뭐…. 또 다른 죄인이: He also said he'll keep pursuing the serpent. As for me... I'm looking for a way to stop what another sinner is doing for Azrael...
strings.그래, 아즈라엘. 자세한 건 그 죄인을 만날 때 물어봐. 나도 아직 이야: Yes, Azrael. Ask that sinner for the details when you meet. I can't tell you yet, either.
strings.그러니 때가 되면, 끝이 되면 다시 만날 수 있을 테니까 잘 있어. 후후: We'll meet again when the time comes, when the end comes. Until then, take care. Hehe.
strings.아, 하나의 진실은 레테가 이야기했으니, 가지고 있는 거로 알고 싶은게: Oh, Lethe already told you one truth. If there's something else you want to know, you'd better use what you're holding.
The moment you leave this territory, you'll lose that right.
My right? And what do you mean, we'll meet at the end...?
strings.(이야기가 끝나자마자 제릴이 어딘가로 향해 사라진다.): (As soon as he finishes speaking, Jeril heads off and disappears.)
That's exactly what Weiss said. What is this 'end'...?
strings.그나저나 여길 나가면 사라진다니…. 알고 싶은 걸 어떻게 알아내야 하는: But if I lose it when I leave... how do I find out what I want to know?
strings.(문득 엘과 제나의 시선과 마주친다.): (The adventurer suddenly meets Ell and Jenna's eyes.)
strings.전 괜찮습니다. 진실이 필요한 부분도 있지만, 그건 제가 직접 밝히면 되: Don't worry about me. There are truths I need, but I can uncover them myself.
strings.그런데 저 사람은 누구죠? 아니, 지금 그게 중요한 게 아니니. 그리고: Who was that person, anyway? No, that isn't important right now. And more than me...
Jenna... There was something you wanted to know, wasn't there? Why you kept the memories of your death.
Is that all right? Using it for me now...?
strings.그럼 어떻게 해야 하지?: But how do I do it?
strings.(고민하고 있던 %s의 앞에 이리스의 환영이 선명하게 나타난다.): (As %s wonders, a clear apparition of Iris appears.)
Iris, are you all right? Earlier...
strings.저는 괜찮아요. 오히려 위로가 됐으니까요. 지금 드릴 말은 그게 아니에요: I'm fine. If anything, it comforted me. But that isn't what I came to say.
It's nice to meet you, Jenna.
You can see me? Ah, you aren't an ordinary person.
strings.오빠 분에게 신세지고 있는 이리스라고 해요. 저에게 가까이 와보시겠어요?: I'm Iris. Your brother has been helping me. Would you come closer?
strings.(제나가 이리스의 곁으로 다가가자 순간 지스크 영지의 느낌이 달라진다.): (As Jenna approaches Iris, the atmosphere of Zisk Territory suddenly changes.)
strings.레테라는 분이 나타났을 때와 같은 공간이네요. 분위긴 좀 다르지만요. 그: This is like the place we were in when Lethe appeared. Though it feels different. Then you must be...
That's right, %s. A place that exists, yet does not exist.
What do we do now? To learn what Jenna wants to know.
strings.손안에 있는 진실의 불꽃에게 말을 거세요. 그리고 진실이 필요한 사람의: Speak to the Flame of Truth in your hand. Then say the name of the person who needs the truth.
Um... There's something I want to know. Jenna. I want to know the truth about Jenna.
strings.(진실의 불꽃에게 말을 걸어보지만, 반응이 없다.): (The adventurer speaks to the Flame of Truth, but it does not respond.)
strings.아, 제가 사라져야 반응할 것 같아요. 너무 걱정하지 마세요. 이 불꽃은: Oh, I think it will only respond after I leave. Don't worry too much. These flames only react to those who possess divine power.
I'll see you again in a little while.
strings.(이리스가 사라지자 보석에서 푸른 불꽃과 붉은 불꽃이 뒤섞여 올라온다.): (When Iris disappears, blue and red flames rise from the jewel, mingling together.)
strings.(불꽃이 점점 커지더니 제나와 %s의 앞에 어떤 장소의 기억이었던 걸 보: (The flames grow larger, then begin to show Jenna and %s what appears to be a memory of a place.)
(An attacking force, a burning village, and a crumbling castle come into view. People's screams mingle in a chorus of agony.)
Father! Father! I can't just leave!
strings.카이엔!! 너만이라도, 너만이라도 제나를 데리고 빠져나가라. 나는 하울: Kaien! At least you must get Jenna out of here! As a noble of the Kingdom of Howl and lord of this land, it is my duty to defend it.
I do not regret this choice. I will do everything I can to protect His Majesty's people.
strings.이 세계의 멸망을 바라는 존재가 많다는 건 알고 있었다. 나는 죄인이 되: I knew there were many who wished for this world's destruction. I came here as a sinner, but finding a witch like you is a surprise.
I will do my part, and you need only do what you can.
Weiss... I must see the lord.
Very well. I'll return, then. Handle things here yourself.
My lord... It has been a long time.
strings.다프네? 네가 어찌 나한테!!: Daphne? How could you do this to me?!
strings.은혜도 모르는 것!! 너희 일족이 데이모스 교단과 왕국에 고통받지 않도록: Ungrateful wretch! I only helped your people so that neither the Deimos cult nor the kingdom would make them suffer... Why must we...
strings.영주님께서 저희 일족을 도와주신 건 감사합니다. 허나 당신의 왕국은 하지: I am grateful for the help you gave our people, my lord. But your kingdom did something it never should have done.
My lord... Even if I told you, you would soon forget.
strings.아, 안 돼!! 다프네, 그만…. 그만, 그만!! 그만 해!! 아, 카이: N-no! Daphne, stop... Stop, stop! Stop it! Kaien, Jenna! Run!
strings.이 마녀!! 내가 널, 끝까지 죽어서도 저주할 것이다!! 처음부터 가까이: You witch! I will curse you to the end, even in death! I should never... never have let you... near us...
strings.아버지, 제나…. 어디 간 거야?: Father, Jenna... Where did you go?
strings.(어둠이 서서히 걷히고, 제나의 슬픈 표정이 시야에 들어온다.): (The darkness slowly lifts, revealing Jenna's sorrowful face.)
So that's what happened. That heavy feeling is finally gone...
I didn't die. I was erased.
strings.그리고 이렇게 여기서 제나라고 인식하고 있는 존재는 오라버니께서 겪은 비: And the being here who thinks of herself as Jenna is a thought-form, created from my brother's grief...
strings.(엘에게 방금 전 있었던 이야기를 한다.): (The adventurer tells Ell what just happened.)
strings.…진실의 불꽃으로 알게 된 제나 님과 스승님의 과거. 이 이야기는 함구하: ...Lady Jenna and Master's past, revealed by the Flame of Truth. I will keep this to myself.
strings.제가 '기억'으로 만들어진 존재라 해도 괜찮아요. 진짜였으면 더 좋았겠지: Even if I'm a being made of 'memories,' that's all right. Though I would have liked to be real.
strings.제가 이렇게 있는 건 오랫동안 이곳을 잊지 않는 오라버니 덕분이니…. 그: I only exist like this because my brother never forgot this place all these years... I can only be grateful.
strings.진실의 불꽃도 얻으셨고, 제 진실도 밝혀주셨으니…. 이제 이곳에서의 일은: You've found the Flame of Truth and uncovered my truth... There is nothing more for you to do here.
strings.저기, 제나. 괜찮아요?: Jenna, are you sure you're all right?
strings.이리스, 이리스!! 어디 있어? 듣고 있어?: Iris! Iris! Where are you? Can you hear me?
strings.(%s의 외침에 이리스의 환영이 모두의 앞에 나타난다. 엘에게는 보이지: (At %s's cry, Iris's apparition appears before them. Ell seems unable to see her and looks completely puzzled.)
The Flame of Truth has the power to reveal the truth. But in exchange...
My memories are true, but my existence isn't. I think I'll disappear soon.
Is there really nothing we can do, Iris...?
strings.%s, 먼저 돌아가주시겠어요?: %s, would you please head back first?
strings.(이리스의 얼굴에 작은 미소가 퍼진다. 엘과 제나는 느끼지 못한 것 같다: (A small smile spreads across Iris's face. Ell and Jenna do not seem to notice.)
strings.(고개를 들어 앞을 바라보니 이리스의 모습이 보이지 않는다.): (When the adventurer looks up again, Iris is gone.)
Is Lady Iris here right now? And Lady Jenna...
Jenna, we'll be going now... It was lovely meeting you.
%s, Ell. Thank you both. I'll never forget you.
We'll be on our way, then...
strings.(제나가 애써 웃으며 두 사람을 배웅한다. 그들의 모습이 더는 지스크 영: (Jenna forces a smile as she sees them off. She keeps waving until they are no longer visible in Zisk Territory.)
strings.흐르는 눈물을 닦으라며. 바람이 나와 그대를 스쳐 지나가네♪: The wind brushes past you and me, whispering to wipe away our falling tears. ♪
strings.대지의 여신이여. 지나가는 바람을 붙잡아 주소서♬: O goddess of the earth, hold fast the passing wind. ♬
Now I remember the next part. That must be my brother's memory, too.
strings.(제나가 눈을 감고 때를 기다린다.): (Jenna closes her eyes and waits for the moment to come.)
strings.(제나가 앞을 바라보니 어떤 여인이 서 있다.): (Jenna looks ahead and sees a woman standing before her.)
How fortunate that you have not yet fallen asleep.
strings.맞아요. 나는 가이아…. 진실의 불꽃이 되찾아준 어떤 기억이 모두에게 많: Yes. I am Gaia... A memory restored by the Flame of Truth has been a great help to everyone.
strings.그래서 당신에게 선물을 주려 해요. 이곳에 남아 주시겠어요?: So I would like to give you a gift. Will you remain here?
strings.이제 제나 지스크의 정신과 기억은 하나가 되었으니 이곳에서 머물 것을 허: Now that Jenna Zisk's spirit and memories are one, I grant you leave to remain in this place.
May painful memories trouble you no longer...
Master is over there. Please wait here a moment.
strings.(멀리 지스카드의 뒷모습이 보인다. 가만히 서 있는 것처럼 보이지만, 어: (Ziskad's back is visible in the distance. He seems to stand still, but his shoulders tremble faintly.)
Well done, Ell. And you too, %s.
strings.(지스카드에게 보석의 형태로 된 진실의 불꽃을 전달한다. 사용법은 굳이: (The adventurer hands Ziskad the Flame of Truth in its jewel form. There seems to be no need to explain how to use it.)
strings.(지스카드 님…, 그나저나 제나는 어떻게 된 걸까?): (Sir Ziskad... But what happened to Jenna?)
You need not worry about Jenna.
By a god's grace, she will not disappear. It seems she will remain in Zisk Territory...
What a relief! Whew... Jenna, I'm so glad...
strings.스승님, 저는 먼저 물러나겠습니다. 두분 말씀에 방해가 될 것 같으니 피: Master, I will leave you now. I would only interrupt your conversation, so I'll step aside.
Thank you, Ell. I'll call for you later.
strings.아, %s 님. 스승님께선 유란 사저의 권유로 금주 중이시니 술을 찾으시: Oh, %s. Master has stopped drinking at Senior Yuran's urging. If he asks for a drink, please stop him.
strings.(말이 끝나기가 무섭게 엘이 화이트콜 협곡 쪽으로 빠르게 움직인다. 일이: (Ell immediately heads toward White Col Canyon, looking relieved that the task is finished.)
strings.지스카드 님…. 이번에도 자연스레 알게 되신 거죠?: Sir Ziskad... You learned it naturally again this time, didn't you?
strings.무슨 말 하려는지 알고 있네. 알고 싶지 않아도 알아야 하지. 목숨을 포: I know what you're going to say. Even if I do not wish to know, I must. Unless I surrender my life.
strings.처음엔 받아들이지 않았지만, 이제는 익숙해져서 괜찮네. 신이 이스트랜드를: I resisted it at first, but I am used to it now. I can think of it as proof that a god loved Eastland.
strings.오늘은 다른 날과는 달리 진심으로 기뻐할 걸세. 여신께도, 자네도, 엘에: Today, unlike other days, I will rejoice wholeheartedly. I have the goddess, you, and Ell to thank...
strings.동생을 지키지 못했다는 죄책감이 컸었던 모양이야. 그런 왜곡된 기억으로: My guilt over failing to protect my sister must have been deep indeed. To think I lived with such distorted memories...
Daphne was the one who brought the Deimos cult to Zisk Territory... It was because of that woman...
When the time comes, I must visit Medea. She may know something.
strings.(메디아, 다프네…. 그러고 보니 제레니스 마법학원의 학원제 이름도 다프: (Medea, Daphne... Come to think of it, Xerenis Magic Academy's festival was called Daphne, too...)
strings.제나를 만나서 어떤 이야기를 할까…?: What shall I say when I see Jenna...?
You must be looking forward to it.
I'll prepare plenty of the things she loved.
strings.비록 살아있는 모습은 아니지만…. 괜찮겠지?: Though she is no longer alive... that will be all right, won't it?
To be able to speak with my sister again... It has already been some four hundred and fifty years...
strings.(지스카드의 표정이 복잡해 보인다. 동생을 만나러 가는 기쁨과 시간에 대: (Ziskad's expression is complicated, mingling joy at seeing his sister with sorrow for the time that has passed.)
Ah, %s... I've kept you waiting. Now, turn your back to me.
strings.(지스카드의 말에 서둘러 등을 보인다. 잠시 후, 거대한 빛이 덮치는 것: (The adventurer quickly turns around. A moment later, an immense light seems to wash over them.)
strings.내가 가진 힘이 이리스 양에게 도움이 됐으면 좋겠군. 자, 이제 본론으로: I hope my power will help Miss Iris. Now, let us return to the matter at hand.
strings.네. 그래서 지스카드 님께서 알고 싶은 진실은 무엇인가요?: Yes. What truth do you wish to learn, Sir Ziskad?
Something concerning Weiss and the Deimos cult... Let me try.
strings.(지스카드의 손 안에서 불꽃이 커지더니 흔들린다. 불꽃이 작은 보석의 형: (The flames in Ziskad's hand swell and flicker. By the time they return to the form of a small jewel, his expression has twisted.)
It lasted only an instant, but I will tell you what I saw.
strings.바이스가 지금까지 보여준 모든 것은 연습이었어. 결정적인 하나를 위한 연: Everything Weiss has done so far was practice. Practice for one decisive act...
strings.내가 보기엔 뒤틀린 자 '데이모스'를 이 땅에 강림시키려 하는 것 같네…: It appears he means to bring the Twisted One, Deimos, down upon this land...
strings.내가 좀 더 알아볼 동안, 자네는 그동안 내가 부를 때까지 휴식을 취하게: While I investigate further, rest until I call for you.
strings.그렇다고 해서 자네가 마냥 쉬고 있을 것 같진 않고. 하하. 그리고 진실: Though I doubt you will simply sit idle. Haha. And I will keep the Flame of Truth somewhere safe.
strings.나는 괜찮네. 아, 부탁이 하나 더 있네. 이곳의 일을 함구해주게. 어차: I am all right. Ah, I have one more request. Keep what happened here to yourself. Everyone will learn of it when the time comes, of course.
You've done well. I'll remain here a while before returning. Go on ahead.
All right. I'll see you later.
strings.(지스카드가 화이트 콜 협곡 쪽으로 향하는 %s의 뒷모습을 오랫동안 바라: (Ziskad watches %s head toward White Col Canyon for a long time.)
strings.(지스카드가 손 안에 있던 진실의 불꽃을 빤히 바라본다.): (Ziskad stares at the Flame of Truth in his hand.)
May you survive to the very end in this world, and remain with everyone.
